lines.rookie: Rain came through the store room roof. Seok, a young sailor, carried all twelve barrels of gunpowder to the turtle ship. He left a note in the King's letters, with a water drop for the rain. The detective showed the Admiral that nothing was stolen. Yi Sun-sin had built the turtle ship before the war. Its front was a dragon's head. On the twelfth day of the fourth month of 1592, its cannons were tested. His war diary records it. The next day, Japanese ships came to Busan, and the war began. In the fifth month, his navy won its first victory at sea, at Okpo.

lines.rookie:
THE SAILORS' LETTER BOARD
The King's letters copy the mouth:
ㄱ = the back of the tongue
ㄴ = the tongue
ㅁ = the lips
ㅅ = the teeth
A stronger sound adds one line.
ㄴ + 1 line = ㄷ
ㅁ + 1 line = ㅂ
A flat line goes under the first sound.
A standing line goes on its right.
A sound at the bottom comes last.

lines.junior: The next day, Japanese ships came to Busan.
lines.master: The next day, Japanese ships filled the sea at Busan.

lines.rookie: The war began. Yi Sun-sin was ready.
lines.junior: The war began, and Yi Sun-sin was ready.
lines.master: The war began, and Yi Sun-sin was ready.

lines.rookie: In month 5, his ships won at Okpo.
lines.junior: In month 5, his ships won at Okpo.
lines.master: In month 5, his ships won their first sea battle, at Okpo.

lines.rookie: The King made easy letters.
lines.junior: The King made easy letters for us.
lines.master: The King made letters so that anyone could learn them easily.

lines.rookie: Even a sailor can write.
lines.junior: Even a sailor can write now.
lines.master: Even a sailor like me can write.

lines.rookie: Ham was asleep. The rain would not wait. So I moved the barrels.
lines.junior: Ham was asleep, and the rain would not wait. So I moved the barrels.
lines.master: Ham was asleep, and the rain would not wait. So I moved the barrels myself.

lines.rookie: I learned them from the board.
lines.junior: I learned them from the board.
lines.master: I learned the King's letters by myself, from the store room board.

lines.rookie: Ham cannot read the King's letters. So I drew a water drop for him. It means rain.
lines.junior: Ham cannot read the King's letters, so I drew a water drop for him. It means rain.
lines.master: Ham reads no King's letters, so I drew him a water drop that even he could read: rain.

lines.rookie: A thief took four barrels.
lines.junior: A thief took four barrels.
lines.master: A thief took four barrels in the night.

lines.rookie: Twelve barrels, same as at sunset. Nothing was taken.
lines.junior: Twelve barrels, the same as at sunset. Nothing was taken.
lines.master: Twelve barrels are on the ship, the same as at sunset. Nothing was stolen.

lines.rookie: Seok moved the powder because the ship's roof let rain in.
lines.junior: Seok moved the powder because the ship's roof let rain in.
lines.master: Seok moved the powder because the ship's roof let the rain in.

lines.rookie: The ship's roof keeps the rain off. Which roof had a hole?
lines.junior: The ship's roof keeps the rain off. Which roof had a hole?
lines.master: The ship's roof keeps the rain off. So which roof had a hole?

lines.rookie: Seok moved all twelve barrels to the turtle ship, out of the rain.
lines.junior: Seok moved all twelve barrels to the turtle ship, out of the rain.
lines.master: Seok carried all twelve barrels to the turtle ship, out of the rain.

lines.rookie: Ham moved the powder to the ship before the rain.
lines.junior: Ham moved the powder to the ship before the rain.
lines.master: Ham carried the powder to the ship before the rain started.

lines.rookie: Ham was asleep. Who said, "So I moved them"?
lines.junior: Ham was asleep. Who said, "So I moved them"?
lines.master: Ham was asleep. Who told you, "So I moved them"?

lines.rookie: What happened to his powder? Show the Admiral.
lines.junior: Show the Admiral what really happened to his powder.
lines.master: Prove to the Admiral what truly became of his powder.

lines.rookie: Ham says Seok took it with no order.
lines.junior: Ham says Seok took it with no order.
lines.master: Ham says Seok took my powder with no order.

lines.rookie: Show me what happened, Detective.
lines.junior: Show me what happened, Detective.
lines.master: Show me what truly happened, Detective.

lines.rookie: The Admiral asks: "Was the store room safe?"
lines.junior: The Admiral asks: "Was the store room safe?"
lines.master: The Admiral asks: "Was the store room safe?"

lines.rookie: No, sir. Rain came through the roof.
lines.junior: No, sir. Rain came in through the roof.
lines.master: No, sir. Rain came through the store room roof, onto the powder.

lines.rookie: And wet powder will not fire.
lines.junior: And wet powder will not fire.
lines.master: And wet powder will not fire.

lines.rookie: Not the store room.
lines.junior: That is not the store room.
lines.master: That card is not about the store room.

lines.rookie: Which card is from the store room?
lines.junior: Which card is from the store room?
lines.master: Which of your cards is from the store room?

lines.rookie: The Admiral asks: "How did you know?"
lines.junior: The Admiral asks: "How did you know?"
lines.master: The Admiral asks: "How did you know where to look?"

lines.rookie: Seok's note named the turtle ship.
lines.junior: Seok's note named the turtle ship.
lines.master: Seok's note named the turtle ship.

lines.rookie: The King's letters. Smart boy.
lines.junior: The King's letters. What a smart boy.
lines.master: A note in the King's letters. What a smart boy.

lines.rookie: That is not where it went.
lines.junior: That is not where it went.
lines.master: That card does not show where the powder went.

lines.rookie: Which card reads the note?
lines.junior: Which card reads the note?
lines.master: Which card tells what the note says?

lines.rookie: The Admiral asks: "Is any of my powder missing?"
lines.junior: The Admiral asks: "Is any of my powder missing?"
lines.master: The Admiral asks: "Is any of my powder missing?"

lines.rookie: None, sir. Twelve dry barrels, as at sunset.
lines.junior: None, sir. Twelve dry barrels, just like at sunset.
lines.master: None, sir. Twelve dry barrels, exactly as at sunset.

lines.rookie: Then nothing was stolen.
lines.junior: Then nothing was stolen.
lines.master: Then nothing at all was stolen.

lines.rookie: That is not the count.
lines.junior: That is not the barrel count.
lines.master: That card does not count the barrels.

lines.rookie: Which card counts the barrels?
lines.junior: Which card counts the barrels?
lines.master: Which card gives the number of barrels?

lines.rookie: TELL THE ADMIRAL
lines.junior: TELL THE ADMIRAL
lines.master: TELL THE ADMIRAL

lines.rookie: all twelve barrels
lines.junior: all twelve barrels
lines.master: all twelve barrels

lines.rookie: out of the rain
lines.junior: out of the rain
lines.master: out of the rain
